location: Nauvis - New Dawn - New Wood Production Sector
summary: Today was a strange day. I woke up to what appeared to be some kind of seismic event. The ground outside my claimed chunks seems to have shifted dramatically.
I do not know what caused the event or whether if it will happen again, but it appears that all of my previous exploration and mapping outside the base have effectively been reset.
For now I am simply grateful that the seismic activity did not affect any of the chunks I have already claimed. All base infrastructure remains intact.
Because of the unexpected terrain changes, I did not accomplish as much as I had originally planned today.
Most of the day was spent claiming additional chunks to the south and expanding the defensive perimeter to cover the newly acquired land.

The defensive expansion alone consumed the majority of the day as new walls, turrets, and ammunition supply lines had to be extended to maintain the same level of security as the original base perimeter.
After securing the area, I began laying out blueprints for another sector of tree farms to increase wood production.
I have not finalized the exact scale of the expansion yet, but my current plan is to construct around twenty forestry units if space allows.
On the technology front, I finished researching High Performance Engine.
More importantly, that research finally revealed the path to Tar Processing, which I have now also completed.
Tar Processing unlocks several recipes that should significantly help address the long standing stone bottleneck affecting science and infrastructure construction.
Once the new wood production sector is complete, my next priority will be setting up the newly unlocked tar processing chains.
